subQuests.subQuestName: Watch the Children of Echoes' dance event

755000102.text: As it turns out, the Children of Echoes sure can dance! Paimon never thought the human body could perform the motions they did onstage!

755000103.text: The rhythmic music, the exciting fireworks... All of that combined brings a totally different vibe from anything we've seen so far!

755000104.text: #Well said, radiant {M#sir}{F#lady}, and your wow-warbling floating doll, too!

755000105.text: Sharp senses, and distinguished, too... Yes. I'm sure you have what it takes to be the vanguard of avant-garde, and a rising star amongst graffiti artists!

755000106.text: So, how about it? Wanna join me, the Dopey Dazzler, in grasping the latest and greatest in trendy artistic thought?

755000107.text: Wow, here comes another person with an odd nickname!

755000110.text: Don't even try changing the subject! This isn't about the "wow" factor or a silly nickname. The important part is what this girl was talking about.

755000111.text: "Avant-garde thought"... Is that the key to Natlan's artistic uniqueness?

755000112.text: Ah, there we go. Very perceptive!

755000113.text: As you can see, the vibrant dances, the frenetic music, the vivid graffiti... All of this has deep connections to the avant-garde.

755000114.text: Fashions, trends, novelty... To us, these are synonyms of "avant-garde."

755000115.text: As for me, the Dopey Dazzler, mainstay of the Graffiti Alliance, I'm trying to encourage a greater understanding of such forward thinking. First Natlan, then the world!

755000116.text: That way, art will constantly evolve, and works of extraordinary aesthetic value may be produced! Ever upwards and on for large-scale graffiti work!
